_note: Kimodo text-to-motion takes for skills where the Mixamo stock clip was weak (docs/design/172). 3 seeds each; the chosen take is copied to art/anim/kimodo/<id>.fbx.

ain_4.why: Mixamo Great Sword Blocking is nearly static
ain_4.prompt: A person braces in a wide stance and raises a two-handed sword horizontally above the head to block a heavy strike, then shoves it away.

ain_1.why: Mixamo Great Sword Slash is 3.53 s
ain_1.prompt: A person swings a large two-handed weapon in a wide horizontal arc from right to left while stepping forward.

ryu_1.prompt: A person performs a fast flurry of slashes with two daggers while stepping forward.

sera_1.why: a quicker throw than Mixamo Throw
